name: Chess
description: Classic chess for two, played on the board: tap a piece, then its square, or drag it there. Chess clocks from bullet to classical, or none. AI players at a strength you choose, with the game's own engine, Stockfish or the Lichess cloud.

settings.label: Show the AI's evaluation of its moves

options.label: Engine (online ones fall back to the own engine)

ai.notice: Online engines need the table host on the internet; without an answer in 10 s the own engine moves. Stockfish (GPL-3.0, https://stockfishchess.org) runs at https://stockfish.online, free for non-commercial use (https://stockfish.online/LICENSE); its search depth (6–15) follows the Elo, and even 6 is strong. Lichess cloud gives the evaluations of positions players have analysed on https://lichess.org (free, open source, AGPL-3.0), and perfect moves from its tablebase with 7 pieces or fewer; in other positions the own engine plays at the Elo chosen.
